sentences.BackgroundOptimiserInfo: Use this if your chosen background image takes too long to load. It will downscale the image and convert it to base64, and then stores it in your browser for faster loading. Even if the BASE64 size is larger, it should load faster being local. Subsequent optimisations will overwrite this cache.
